column1: # Mirror the Sloane Camera personnel-database sort flow from the
# tutorial: title in row 1, field-name row in row 3, records in
# rows 4-8. Two sorts: first by LASTNAME ascending, then by LOCATION
# ascending with LASTNAME as the secondary key.
#   - /Data Sort Data-Range — POINT for the records (excludes the
#     field-name row so headers aren't sorted into the data).
#   - /Data Sort Primary-Key — POINT in the desired key column;
#     follow-up Asc/Desc submenu binds the direction.
#   - /Data Sort Secondary-Key — same shape; ties on the primary key
#   - /Data Sort Go — execute the sort and return to READY.
#   - The Sort menu is sticky: each leaf returns to it so the user
#     can stack settings before pressing Go.
